metadata.title: the dijker — move yourself
metadata.description: The dijker is a new type of vehicle that feels quite familiar at the same time. A high-tech vehicle with its unique spiral belt drive multispeed®.

hero.title: the dijker
hero.lead: As if it has always existed: the dijker. A new type of vehicle that feels quite familiar at the same time. It breathes nostalgia.
hero.sub: But don't let the classic lines fool you — the dijker is a high-tech vehicle with its unique spiral belt drive multispeed®.

dijker.heading: The dijker
dijker.intro: These are five unique properties of the dijker. Just read.
dijker.body1: The dijker is a new type of vehicle. It has four wheels and a small steering wheel that you push to brake. It has pedals for the drive that move back and forth in a straight line, left and right independently. The body consists of a handy undivided luggage compartment (the boot) and a nose cover — both easily taken off.
dijker.body2: Furthermore: there are no brake handles, and no handles for changing gear either — the adjustment is done by moving your toes backwards. All handles have been designed away. To ride a dijker is a new experience. To ride a dijker is fun.

boot.title: boot
boot.text: The body consists of a handy undivided luggage compartment — the boot — and a nose cover. Both can be taken off very easily.

comfort.title: comfort
comfort.text: A newly designed alternative for commuters who now travel by car, motorcycle or public transport. Comfortable, dry and pleasant — thanks to the sitting position you arrive rested and relaxed. Even with the front cover on there is plenty of ventilation, and the open-fabric backrest lets you hang a jacket over it.

fast.title: fast
fast.text: You push with both legs at the same time and the weight is minimal. Acceleration from standstill is quick, and at speed the aerodynamics help you along.

free.title: free
free.text: Thanks to the open design of the vehicle you get in and out easily. You'll never feel trapped.

protects.title: protects
protects.text: On the road you are well protected by the four strong wheels and the sturdy chassis. A mini poncho between the boot and the nose cover keeps out cold and rain, and a design flag with striking colors keeps you visible.

technique.heading: The technique
technique.chassis: The basis of the dijker is the chassis: a flat element that integrates suspension, steering rack, pedal guidance and brake distribution. It also protects the brake cables, the electrics and the drive belt linings with sheathing. Strong and light.
technique.drive: The integral drive system combines drive with a gear system. The left or right belt is wound around a wheel axle in a spiral; the diameter increases or decreases by adding or removing belt length while pushing. You can even downshift at a standstill — impossible with a derailleur on a bicycle.
technique.brakes: All four wheels have light metal drum brakes, operated by pressing the steering column with the steering wheel. Unexpected, but intuitive and safe in practice.
technique.award: Third prize at the Germersheim Spezialradmesse 2019 inventor competition.

creator.heading: The creator
creator.name: Peter-Paul van der Ven
creator.body1: Peter-Paul is passionate and future-oriented, with extensive knowledge of physics, materials, tribology, and the design and testing of (sandwich) structures and linear pedal mechanisms.
creator.body2: The dijker is a boy's dream come true for him. From childhood he watched our fragile atmosphere pollute. He was determined to make small vehicles with little or no exhaust fumes — vehicles he would really like to ride, and that in the end even car owners would prefer.

investing.heading: Investing
investing.body: The dijker is the result of vision and perseverance. The next step is further development and marketing. Would you like to invest in the dijker, or take a major role in the project? Then get in touch.
